THAT IS A REGISTERED OUTCOME, NOT A FAILURE, AND SITTING IN A QUEUE DOES NOT OVERRIDE IT.
The run root MUST already exist (phases 2-4 continue a run they did not start), so the queue AGE-GUARD is pointed at the CASE directory, not the run root.
